## Frequently Asked Questions

### How does Capsule’s 14-day trial work?![](https://capsulecrm.com/icons/open-accordion.svg)

Capsule’s 14-day trial of its paid plans (Starter, Growth, Advanced and Ultimate) begins as soon as you sign up for one of the plans. You’ll be able to utilize all the features available on the plan you’re trialing and add your team to the account too.

### What happens at the end of the free trial?![](https://capsulecrm.com/icons/open-accordion.svg)

At the end of the free trial, you can choose to continue on the paid plan you’ve selected, switch to another plan, or cancel your subscription to Capsule entirely. To continue using Capsule with the data you’ve added already, simply enter your payment details and you’re all set.

### Are there any setup fees for opening a Capsule account?![](https://capsulecrm.com/icons/open-accordion.svg)

There are zero setup fees associated with opening a Capsule account. You can also cancel your account at any time.

### What are the most common Capsule integrations?![](https://capsulecrm.com/icons/open-accordion.svg)

Capsule supports 60+ integrations, and works with Zapier to fulfill additional functionality. Our most popular integrations include Transpond, Mailchimp, Xero, QuickBooks, Gmail and Office 365.

### Can I migrate my contact data into Capsule?![](https://capsulecrm.com/icons/open-accordion.svg)

Yes. Capsule has many options for migrating data from spreadsheets into our CRM. You can import Contacts and Opportunities. You’ll also be able to integrate some data with select integrations Capsule supports.

[More information is available here.](https://capsulecrm.com/support/importing-and-migrating-data/getting-started-with-importing-and-migration/)

### What does onboarding look like with Capsule?![](https://capsulecrm.com/icons/open-accordion.svg)

Unlike other CRMs, Capsule is quick to implement and easy to use. It’s been designed by leading UX experts with rapid adoption and convenience front and center.

As soon as you open an account with Capsule, you’ll be guided through an in-app, multi-step process to teach you how to get started. You’ll also have access to our support center, stocked with insightful articles to teach you more about your new CRM.

Lastly, our support team is always available to answer your questions, as and when they come up.

### How much does it cost to onboard?![](https://capsulecrm.com/icons/open-accordion.svg)

Nothing. Capsule charges **zero fees** for its onboarding.

### Who is Capsule best suited for?![](https://capsulecrm.com/icons/open-accordion.svg)

Capsule’s plans are tailored for organizations at different growth stages and across different industries. Our starter plan is ideal for individuals and small businesses seeking to become more efficient and effective with their client and supplier relationships.

Growth and Advanced are better suited for larger SMBs, seeking to accelerate their growth journey, with a larger contact database, bespoke email templates, multiple sales pipelines, project management features, workflow automations and much more.

Ultimate is designed specifically for larger SMBs wanting to enjoy enterprise CRM functionality at SMB prices.

### What is a free Capsule plan?![](https://capsulecrm.com/icons/open-accordion.svg)

Our free plan has limited features and functionality compared to our paid tiers. For instance, you can only have 250 contacts, two users, and a single project board and Sales Pipeline.

However, the free version of Capsule is great for individuals wanting to test the functionality of Capsule, so you can upgrade to a paid plan when you’re ready.

### What features are limited during the 14-day trial?![](https://capsulecrm.com/icons/open-accordion.svg)

None! You can use any feature, connect any integrations and add as many users as you see fit.

### Can you switch your Capsule plan?![](https://capsulecrm.com/icons/open-accordion.svg)

Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade.

The only caveat with downgrading your Capsule subscription is that you’ll need to stay within the limits of the plan you’re switching to.

For instance, if you were on the Growth plan, had 60,000 contacts and wanted to downgrade to our Starter package, you’d need to remove 30,000 contacts to comply with the 30,000 contact limit in the Starter plan.

### What payment methods do you accept?![](https://capsulecrm.com/icons/open-accordion.svg)

We accept most major credit and debit cards.

### What payment options do you offer?![](https://capsulecrm.com/icons/open-accordion.svg)

You can choose to pay monthly or annually.

We always recommend customers choose our annual plan. We offer up to 15% discount for customers who subscribe to our annual pricing plan, making Capsule a little less expensive.

### What is Transpond?![](https://capsulecrm.com/icons/open-accordion.svg)

Transpond is an email marketing suite owned by Capsule. It’s been designed to work hand in hand with our CRM to help SMBs deliver better outcomes for their marketing campaigns.

It features a suite of useful tools such as email marketing, webforms, advanced marketing analytics, automations and so much more.

Unlike other integrations, Transpond benefits from being natively integrated with Capsule, so you can track the performance of your lead nurture campaigns directly against contacts in our CRM.

### Does Capsule CRM have AI features?![](https://capsulecrm.com/icons/open-accordion.svg)

Yes, we do! We’ve got a dedicated [AI page](https://capsulecrm.com/ai/) that explains all of our AI features. They’re super useful, and really help speed up your working day.

But, we know that AI isn’t for everyone. This is why we’ve been really deliberate about how we implement the technology into our tool.

- Capsule CRM never uses your data to train AI models — it stays yours
- Account and customer data is protected using the same safeguards as the rest of Capsule CRM.
- Data entered into AI features isn’t shared outside your Capsule CRM account.

Also, if you don’t want to use the AI features in Capsule CRM, you can switch these off in your account.

### [Make every dollar count with budget-friendly pricing permalink](https://capsulecrm.com/blog/CRM-pricing/#make-every-dollar-count-with-budget-friendly-pricing)**Make every dollar count with budget-friendly pricing**
Its free plan gives small businesses essential features, while paid plans start at just $18 per user per month. Unlike other CRMs, Capsule doesn’t charge for “extras” that are actually essentials, like [contact management](https://capsulecrm.com/features/contact-management-software/) or [pipeline tracking](https://capsulecrm.com/features/sales-pipeline/).

## FAQ: CRM software pricing
### How much does a CRM usually cost?![](https://capsulecrm.com/icons/open-accordion.svg)
CRM pricing can vary widely, depending on features and user needs. For small businesses, affordable CRM solutions often start at $10–$20 per user per month. Mid-tier plans with advanced features like task management, pipeline management features, and email templates typically range between $30 and $60 per user per month. Complex CRM tools or enterprise-level plans with unlimited contacts and custom user permissions can cost even hundreds of dollars monthly.

### Which CRM is the cheapest?![](https://capsulecrm.com/icons/open-accordion.svg)
There are various CRM software providers offering starter CRM plans at reasonable price. For budget-conscious users, Capsule CRM stands out with a free plan for small teams and affordable paid tiers starting at $18 per user per month.

### Do you have to pay for CRM?![](https://capsulecrm.com/icons/open-accordion.svg)
Not always. Many CRM providers, including Capsule CRM, offer free plans with basic CRM features like task management and contact tracking. However, premium features like custom user permissions, pipeline management features, and advanced sales management tools typically require a paid CRM subscription.

### What are the fees of CRM?![](https://capsulecrm.com/icons/open-accordion.svg)
CRM fees depend on the platform, features, and user count. Affordable CRM solutions start at $10–$30 per user per month. Tools with advanced features like pipeline management features, marketing campaigns, and email templates may cost more. For enterprise plans, fees can range from $100 to $300 per user monthly, depending on the CRM provider.

### What’s the average cost per user for a CRM?![](https://capsulecrm.com/icons/open-accordion.svg)
CRM pricing often depends on the features included. Many platforms, like Capsule CRM, offer affordable per-user plans that provide essential tools like sales analytics and customer relationship management without breaking the budget.

### Which CRM software combines sales analytics with seamless customer relationship management?![](https://capsulecrm.com/icons/open-accordion.svg)
Capsule CRM stands out for its ability to blend intuitive customer relationship management features with actionable sales analytics, all in an affordable per-user pricing model.

If you’ve ever Googled 'CRM pricing,' you probably felt two things: curiosity and confusion. From 'freemium' models with asterisks everywhere to packages priced like luxury cars, CRM pricing can feel very confusing. But it doesn’t have to be.

In this guide, we’re breaking down the costs of popular CRMs to help you figure out what’s worth paying for. **Hint:** you don’t need to blow your budget to get a CRM that meets your needs.

As we explore different pricing structures, keep an eye out for one thing: value. At Capsule CRM, we believe in straightforward pricing that helps businesses grow, not paying over the odds. But don’t just take our word for it – let’s check the details and uncover the numbers.

## [CRM pricing comparison permalink](https://capsulecrm.com/blog/CRM-pricing/\#crm-pricing-comparison)**CRM pricing comparison**

### [\#1 - Copper CRM pricing permalink](https://capsulecrm.com/blog/CRM-pricing/\#1---copper-crm-pricing)**\#1 - Copper CRM pricing**

Copper CRM provides four pricing tiers tailored to businesses of different sizes:

- **Starter Plan – $12/user/month**

Includes 1,000 contact limit, Google Workspace integration, and basic CRM features like tasks and an activity feed
- **Basic Plan – $29/user/month** Supports 2,500 contacts and adds task automation, pipeline management features, and project management tools
- **Professional Plan – $69/user/month** Offers 15,000 contact limit, workflow automation, bulk email, and advanced reporting tools.
- **Business Plan – $134/user/month** Unlimited contacts, premium support, multi-currency features, and custom reports with advanced analytics.

While Copper CRM integrates with Google Workspace, the cost rises quickly as your team scales. For small businesses or growing teams looking for affordable CRM options with broader integrations, there are alternatives to consider.

👉 [**Explore our full breakdown of Copper CRM pricing**](https://capsulecrm.com/blog/Copper-CRM-pricing/).

### [\#2 - Zoho CRM pricing permalink](https://capsulecrm.com/blog/CRM-pricing/\#2---zoho-crm-pricing)**\#2 - Zoho CRM pricing**

Zoho CRM offers tiered pricing to fit different business sizes and needs:

- **Free plan – Up to 3 users** Basic CRM functionality like email tracking, leads, contacts, and mobile apps. Limited storage and restricted automation.
- **Standard plan – $20/user/month** Advanced filters, email insights, scoring rules, and 155 custom fields/module. Lacks advanced analytics or AI tools.
- **Professional plan – $35/user/month** Adds sales forecasting, inventory management, email parsing, and up to 300 custom fields/module. Workflow automation is capped.
- **Enterprise plan – $50/user/month** Includes AI assistant (Zia), sandboxing, advanced analytics, and unlimited custom reports. Limited sandbox environments for testing.
- **Ultimate Plan – $65/user/month** Offers extensive AI tools, unlimited dashboards, and premium customer support. Complexity in customization may require technical assistance.

Zoho CRM provides a wide range of features, but its complexity and additional costs for higher-tier tools like advanced analytics and AI may make it less ideal for small or growing businesses.

👉 [**Get a complete breakdown of Zoho CRM pricing options**](https://capsulecrm.com/blog/Zoho-CRM-pricing/).

### [\#3 - Salesforce CRM pricing permalink](https://capsulecrm.com/blog/CRM-pricing/\#3---salesforce-crm-pricing)**\#3 - Salesforce CRM pricing**

With its extensive features and scalable pricing, Salesforce CRM supports businesses across multiple sectors.

#### **Salesforce CRM pricing plans**

- **Essentials – $25/user/month**

Basic account and contact management, lead tracking, email integration, and mobile app access. However, it lacks automation, advanced reporting, and customization options.
- **Professional – $75/user/month** Includes pipeline management, custom dashboards, collaborative forecasting, and reporting for customer data. Features are solid, but costs are higher than comparable options.
- **Enterprise – $150/user/month**

Offers unlimited customizations, API integration, and advanced workflow automation. Ideal for large teams but expensive for small-to-medium businesses.
- **Unlimited – $300/user/month**

All-inclusive plan with dedicated account management, advanced analytics, premier support, and onboarding services. Suitable only for large enterprises with complex needs.

While Salesforce’s starting price appears reasonable, costs can quickly increase with essential add-ons like Marketing Cloud, Einstein AI, or extra storage. Its rigid pricing model and additional expenses may make it challenging for businesses to budget effectively.

**👉 [Get the full picture of Salesforce CRM pricing in our guide](https://capsulecrm.com/blog/salesforce-crm-pricing/).**

### [\#4 - Pipedrive CRM pricing permalink](https://capsulecrm.com/blog/CRM-pricing/\#4---pipedrive-crm-pricing)**\#4 - Pipedrive CRM pricing**

Pipedrive CRM is designed for sales-led teams focusing on pipeline management and organization.

#### **Pipedrive CRM pricing plans**

- **Essential plan – $19.90/user/month** Customizable pipelines, Google Drive sync, and basic sales reporting. Limited functionality, with no workflow automation or advanced analytics.
- **Advanced plan – $34.90/user/month** Adds email templates, open tracking, workflow automation, and scheduler tools. Reporting customization remains limited.
- **Professional plan – $59.90/user/month**

Unlimited workflows, revenue forecasting, and advanced reporting for up to 100,000 contacts. May not justify the price for small teams.
- **Power plan – $74.90/user/month**

Priority support, custom deal fields, and enhanced integrations. Costs climb with additional users and required add-ons.
- **Enterprise plan – $94.90/user/month**

Dedicated account management, unlimited feature access, and custom onboarding. Suited for large-scale operations.

Pipedrive CRM pricing appears competitive at first glance, but its reliance on add-ons can make it less cost-effective for some businesses. The lack of advanced features in lower tiers often pushes users to upgrade faster than expected.

👉 **[Compare Pipedrive CRM pricing plans in our detailed overview](https://capsulecrm.com/blog/pipedrive-crm-pricing/).**

### [\#5 - HubSpot CRM pricing permalink](https://capsulecrm.com/blog/CRM-pricing/\#5---hubspot-crm-pricing)**\#5 - HubSpot CRM pricing**

HubSpot CRM offers a customizable platform with pricing plans that align with many business objectives.

HubSpot has separate pricing for its CRM platform and sales products. Here are useful benchmarks in USD:

- **Free sales tools — $0:** Basic CRM features for up to two users.
- **Sales Hub Starter — from $7/seat/month promotional:** Standard price shown at $20 per seat per month; promotional terms may apply.
- **Smart CRM Professional — from $45/seat/month with annual commitment:** CRM reporting, data configuration and management features.
- **Smart CRM Enterprise — from $75/seat/month:** Advanced CRM customization and controls.

### How much does a CRM usually cost?![](https://capsulecrm.com/icons/open-accordion.svg)

CRM pricing can vary widely, depending on features and user needs. For small businesses, affordable CRM solutions often start at $10–$20 per user per month. Mid-tier plans with advanced features like task management, pipeline management features, and email templates typically range between $30 and $60 per user per month. Complex CRM tools or enterprise-level plans with unlimited contacts and custom user permissions can cost even hundreds of dollars monthly.

### Which CRM is the cheapest?![](https://capsulecrm.com/icons/open-accordion.svg)

There are various CRM software providers offering starter CRM plans at reasonable price. For budget-conscious users, Capsule CRM stands out with a free plan for small teams and affordable paid tiers starting at $18 per user per month.

Yes, [Monday.com](http://monday.com/) includes a CRM platform tailored for task management, sales workflows, and project tracking. Its flexibility makes it ideal for businesses looking to handle marketing campaigns and sales pipelines in one place. With custom user permissions and email templates, Monday CRM bridges the gap between project management and sales management.

### What is the best CRM for small business?![](https://capsulecrm.com/icons/open-accordion.svg)

The right CRM solution for small businesses depends on their needs. Capsule CRM is a top choice for its intuitive design and ability to generate in-depth reports without the complexity of larger platforms.
